# Plans & Billing

Frontend has two plans. AI usage isn’t part of either: the [agents](/agents/overview) run on your own accounts with their providers.

| | Free | Plus |
|---|---|---|
| Price | $0 | $20 per seat per month |
| Projects | 10 | Unlimited |
| Members | 1 | One per seat |
| [Browser runtime](/sandboxes/browser) | Unlimited | Unlimited |
| [Server runtime](/sandboxes/server) | — | 40 compute hours per seat each month, shared across the team |
| Agents | Claude Code, OpenCode, Pi | Claude Code, OpenCode, Pi, Codex |
| [Publishing](/features/publishing) | Share previews only | Up to 100 published projects |
| [Custom domains](/features/custom-domains) | — | ✓ |
| [Analytics](/features/analytics) | — | ✓ |
| Integrations | ✓ | ✓ |

## Seats

Section titled “Seats”

Plus is billed per seat, and each member of the team is a seat. Seats follow your members, so adding someone to the team adds a seat to the subscription and removing them removes it. Each seat adds 40 hours of server compute to the team’s shared pool.

## Managing your subscription

Section titled “Managing your subscription”

Upgrade, see your seats and compute hours, and manage billing from your team’s **Subscription** page. Only the team’s owner can cancel the subscription.

## AI costs

Section titled “AI costs”

Frontend doesn’t charge for AI. Each agent signs in with your own account, and its usage is billed by its provider:

- [Claude Code](/agents/claude-code) — your Claude plan or Anthropic API usage
- [Codex](/agents/codex) — your ChatGPT plan or OpenAI API usage
- [OpenCode](/agents/opencode) and [Pi](/agents/pi) — the provider you connect
- Image and video generation — your team’s [OpenRouter](/integrations/openrouter) account
